description: This file implements the PackageManager class for handling package download, installation, uninstallation, and management within a plugin framework. It includes methods for registering notifications, managing download threads, and interfacing with storage and package components.

classes.name: PackageManagerImplementation
classes.description: Implements package management functionalities including download, install, uninstall, and notification handling within the plugin framework.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a download notification callback.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a download notification callback.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the package manager with the given service, setting up storage and download thread.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the package manager, releasing resources.

methods.name: createStorageManagerObject
methods.description: Creates the storage manager object via the current service.

methods.name: releaseStorageManagerObject
methods.description: Releases the storage manager object.

methods.name: Download
methods.description: Starts downloading a package from a URL with specified options.

methods.name: Pause
methods.description: Pauses an ongoing download by download ID.

methods.name: Resume
methods.description: Resumes a paused download by download ID.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing download by download ID.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a downloaded file given its locator.

methods.name: Progress
methods.description: Retrieves progress information for a download.

methods.name: GetStorageDetails
methods.description: Retrieves storage quota and usage details.

methods.name: RateLimit
methods.description: Sets a rate limit for a download.

methods.name: Install
methods.description: Installs a package from a file locator with optional metadata.

methods.name: Uninstall
methods.description: Uninstalls a package by ID.

methods.name: ListPackages
methods.description: Lists all installed packages.

methods.name: Config
methods.description: Retrieves runtime configuration for a package.

methods.name: PackageState
methods.description: Retrieves the installation state of a package.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers an installation notification callback.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters an installation notification callback.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks a package for exclusive access.

methods.name: Unlock
methods.description: Unlocks a previously locked package.

methods.name: GetLockedInfo
methods.description: Retrieves lock info for a package.

methods.name: InitializeState
methods.description: Initializes internal state and package metadata.

methods.name: downloader
methods.description: Background thread function for handling downloads.

methods.name: NotifyDownloadStatus
methods.description: Notifies registered observers about download status updates.

methods.name: NotifyInstallStatus
methods.description: Notifies registered observers about installation status updates.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Retrieves the next download info from the queue.
